title: AppleJuice
description: This project adds better performance, smoother animations, improved visuals, better HUDs, quality of life features, and many immersive resource packs while keeping the vanilla Minecraft style.
body:
AppleJuice is a vanilla+ Fabric modpack focused on visuals, animations, immersion, and performance. It adds smoother movement, better particles, updated GUI/HUD elements, improved first-person animations, 3D models, voice chat, minimaps, and many quality of life features while still keeping the original Minecraft feeling.


The pack also includes many optimization mods to improve FPS and make gameplay smoother, even with shaders and resource packs enabled, all the silly stuff you'll need in one modpack.
